title: Parokya ni Edgar, Sponge Cola to headline Halloween celebration in Boracay
summary: Parokya ni Edgar and Sponge Cola will headline Hallowave 2026, a day-long Halloween celebration at Boracay Newcoast on October 31, featuring live music, family activities, food and outdoor adventures.
